title: Formal Group Portrait of Two Couples, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white photograph featuring two middle-aged couples dressed in formal attire outdoors, likely attending a wedding or special family celebration in 1941. The women wear classic 1940s dresses with floral corsages pinned to their chest, while the men wear sharp dark suits and ties, with one holding a fedora hat. Vintage automobiles are partially visible parked nearby in the background.
